verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a hosted REST API with API-key auth and run endpoints such as POST /v1/run/tasks, published in an OpenAPI 3.1 spec. You send a prompt and URL, Skyvern runs a cloud browser, and you get structured output back, so the caller never manages a browser. Passing webhook_url makes Skyvern send one POST when the run reaches a terminal status. missing for 10: an explicitly documented run-status polling endpoint (runs are only implied by the API reference and run-status debugging docs), independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted API and webhook flow.
